skills.elemental_burst: Unleashes waves that will deal AoE Hydro DMG based on Neuvillette's Max HP. After a short interval, waterfalls will descend and deal Hydro DMG in a somewhat smaller AoE, and will generate Sourcewater Droplets within an area in front. Sourcewater Droplets generated by Neuvillette can be absorbed by the Hydro Traveler and vice versa. Up to Sourcewater Droplets spawned by Neuvillette can exist at one time. If more Sourcewater Droplets are created while there are on the field, the oldest Sourcewater Droplets will despawn. Sourcewater Droplets spawned by Hydro Traveler do not count towards this limit.
